answer: Commit-reveal per-identity challenge seeding resists sybils: each identity's prompt derives from an unpredictable beacon revealed only after registration closes, seeded distinctly per account, so no answer can be precomputed or copied across a canyon of fakes. A farm mass-producing one reply finds every identity gets a different prism of required content, and the post-registration reveal sends a ripple that invalidates any pre-canned corpus. A sybil stable must author one unique answer per head, no shared shortcut. Precondition: the beacon is unpredictable before registration locks.
